fuel_consumption.source_quote: Our business plan assumes that in 2006 our aircraft fuel consumption will be approximately 2.1 billion gallons and that our average annual jet fuel price per gallon will be approximately $1.74.

instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedge contracts at December 31, 2005 or 2004. Delta was in Chapter 11 bankruptcy (filed September 14, 2005). Bankruptcy Court authorized fuel hedging up to 30% of monthly consumption in December 2005; Creditors Committee approved up to 50% of 2006 aggregate consumption in February 2006, but no contracts were outstanding at Dec 31, 2005. Note 6 confirms: 'We did not have any fuel hedge contracts at December 31, 2005 or 2004.' For February 2006, approximately 26% of fuel needs were hedged (subsequent event).
